preservedDomainDetails.detail: Focus visibility and semantic role remain required for equivalent keyboard access.
Credential redaction must cover structured and fallback error formatting.
The event identity key must survive the retry boundary to prevent duplicate side effects.
Wall-clock verification must cover both skipped and repeated local times.

counterexamples: Keyboard activation concerns equivalent input accessibility, whereas CLI redaction concerns disclosure at an error-output boundary.
Hook retry idempotency requires exactly one domain side effect, whereas scheduler correctness requires execution at the configured local time across time-zone transitions.
A single cross-surface rule would weaken distinct observable guarantees for accessibility, privacy, idempotency, and wall-clock semantics.
behaviorLostIfApproved: No cleanup is proposed; merging these rules would lose their distinct triggers, execution guarantees, and observable acceptance criteria.
